#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    int n, B;
    cin >> n >> B;
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }

    map<int, int> freq;
    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if ((arr[i] & 1) == 0) {
            ++even;
        } else {
            ++odd;
        }
        if (even == odd) {
            int cost = abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]);
            ++freq[cost];
        }
    }

    int budget = B;
    long long ans = 0;
    if (budget >= 0) {
        for (auto& entry : freq) {
            int cost = entry.first;
            int count = entry.second;
            for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
                budget -= cost;
                if (budget < 0) {
                    goto outer_end;
                }
                ++ans;
            }
        }
        outer_end:;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
